current_scoring_authority: Only scoring_rules.json awards points. Supporting items and historical records carry no numerical or independent points gates.

items.expected: From chemically mapped comparable full molecular structures, establish that the PO-derived terminal oxygen has a compact P contact together with N-ethyl CH2/CH3-H contacts, whereas the PA-derived terminal oxygen is distributed across the N-ethyl hydrogen contact environment with a more remote P contact. Explain the local structural reorganization using the H-contact network, not merely the two requested O-P distances, which remain structural evidence. Define alpha/beta hydrogens by the P-N-CH2-CH3 graph; do not equate the nearest H or a family mean with an unmapped figure label. A contact pattern alone does not establish a binding energy or rate.

items.statement: Spatial electrostatic separation in the PA-derived species
items.expected: Actual signed ESP and/or spatially resolved compatible charge analysis supports a positive onium-region versus negative carboxylate-oxygen pattern in the PA zwitterion. Specify sign, physical quantity and region; a blue image described as increased electron density is not evidence of this result. Physical definition: Complete neutral singlet free (Et2N)3P, PO adduct and PA adduct: 46/56/61 atoms, with intact supplied chemical graphs and comparable relaxed gas-phase local structures. Map phosphorus, the chemically corresponding terminal oxygen and N-ethyl CH2/CH3 hydrogen classes by connectivity; source atom numbers are an evaluator crosswalk, not required agent labels. Report the requested free/PO/PA phosphorus ADCH populations as evidence under their stated definition; do not relabel another charge partition as ADCH. These populations have no numerical matching gate and are not a prerequisite to an independently established equivalent spatial electrostatic explanation. Spatial ESP or other justified density analysis may independently establish semantic electrostatic claims. Alternative electronic-structure implementations must preserve identity, electronic state, environment and observable. The incomplete source PA coordinate block is not a mandatory starting route; the full C20H34N3O3P graph is required. Molecular probe observations are separate from bulk 80 C CO2/PO polymerization kinetics.
